event: Only a single configuration is built; no sweep.

I verified the finding: no test checks that the MCU mailbox SRAM size is configurable.

Each testbench build uses one fixed size, for example `MCU_MBOX0_SIZE_KB = 256` in `src/integration/testbench/tb_top_pkg.sv`. The smoke test `cptra_smoke_test_mcu_mbox_axi_param.c` reads the configured size and adapts its addresses to it, but never changes the size or checks configurability. I found no regression or test that varies `MCU_MBOX*_SIZE_KB`. I also found no file containing the plan text "SRAM size between", so no test implements that plan item.

The init-time size assertions in `src/mci/rtl/mci_top.sv` only check the bounds of the single configured value.

The verdict was accepted on the second attempt. The first call failed because the tool wasn't available under that name.
